reasonForResult: Multiple critical TTB violations found across both panels: (1) No alcohol content (ABV) statement appears anywhere on the label — the Nutrition Facts panel is present but omits the required '% Alc. by Vol.' declaration, which is mandatory for all alcohol beverages. (2) The mandatory Government Warning (27 CFR 16.21) is completely absent from both panels. (3) The label contains numerous prohibited health and therapeutic claims in direct violation of TTB Notice 884 (2012): 'BOOSTS ENERGY', 'BUILDS IMMUNITY', 'BURNS CALORIES', 'GOOD FOR YOUR HEART', 'IMPROVES FOCUS', 'PROMOTES WELLNESS', 'LIVE BOLDER. FEEL BETTER.', and 'Why just relax when you can THRIVE?' — all imply health benefits, therapeutic effects, or wellness outcomes from consuming an alcohol beverage, which is expressly prohibited. The cap (panel 2) adds 'POSITIVE ENERGY IN EVERY SIP', a further implied health benefit claim.
